title: London Bridge Is Falling Down
source: Traditional melody as given in the Wikipedia article's LilyPond score (F major, 2/4, first/second endings unfolded), transposed down a fifth to C major with note values doubled to fit 4/4 in 8 bars, and arranged for this project with beginner fingering in a D-A hand position (D=1 to A=5, the closing C taken with the thumb).
